summary: Inaugural session of spectral-attribution. The log is instituted before the root commit, so that no work of this session sits outside it. The apparatus was written first and left untracked, so that the root commit can hold the preregistration alone.

Dash gate, effort log, figure gate, untouchable gate, gate runner, hook installer and test suite written and installed. Reused by reading from the closed prior lane, with provenance declared, and extended with tests this lane needs.

The signed design written: the question, the signal and the bit convention quoted from the deposit at its tag, the selection bias, the two nulls, the attribution as primary quantity, the refutation criterion with its failability checked in both directions, multiplicity, sample size, seed, and what will not be claimed.

Figure registry opened with the figures this lane is most likely to repeat by reflex: the two the audited footnote prints, the four of the auditor's unregistered exploration, its draw count, and the two constants this lane derived by hand and has not executed. Every one is unusable in a commit message until an artefact here produces it.
Root commit made. Its tree holds one path and the working tree held the apparatus untracked, which is declared rather than tidied.

Contact rules written: the deposit under audit read only at its tag, the closed lane read only at its final head and not citable, the two deposited neighbours read only at their tags, the untouchable lane, birth with no remote, and the manifest rule for files this lane did not produce.

Term gate run with declared queries. The name is occupied by exact string as a public repository and as a compound term of art in machine learning interpretability. Rename recommended, decision left open and belonging to Alexis.

Provenance of the reused apparatus declared, with the commit read, the digest of every file read, what changed in each, and the reason the sampler is reimplemented from the signed definition rather than copied.

The untouchable gate refused its own test suite on the first real run: the new pattern tests named an untouchable repository as a literal. Fixed by building every fixture from the tool's own list at run time, not by exempting the enforcer. Nothing entered the history.

Standing documents opened: the reference list with a verification status on every entry, the background review declared unstarted with its future scope fixed now, the manifest with no contents and one anticipated entry, and the decision register with nothing decided and four decisions named as belonging to Alexis.

Two route validation declared before any sampler exists: the published membership predicate read at its deposit tag, and five exact facts fixed in the signed document. Tolerances, stop rules, the order of operations and the inheritance accounting from the closed lane are all fixed here.
